# Vendored front-end libraries

Bundled so the UI works offline (RunMD ships as a single binary). Do not edit.

| File | Package | Version | License |
|------|---------|---------|---------|
| `marked.min.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) | 12.0.2 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 |
| `vis-network.min.js` | [vis-network](https://github.com/visjs/vis-network) (standalone UMD) | 9.1.9 | Apache-2.0 / MIT |
| `tailwind.css` | generated by [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) 3.4.17 | — | MIT (output of `make css`) |
